sources.summary: Continental Drift: Encounters, North and South An exhibition presented by browngrotta arts October 17–25, 2026 | Wilton, Connecticut This October, browngrotta arts presents Continental Drift: Encounters, North and South, an exhibition exploring how artistic tradition migrates, transforms, and takes root across the Americas — and beyond. The show brings together more than 40 leading fiber and sculptural artists, tracing lines of influence that cross borders, generations, and continents. About the Exhibition The exhibition takes its name from the geological process by which continents slowly separate, collide, and reshape one another over time — a metaphor the gallery uses to examine how artistic traditions move across
